caption:
Hosting a ghar party tonight? Large Sahab’s checklist. 🥃

A water station everyone can see. Enough real glasses. Dinner by ten. A sofa made up for anyone who shouldn’t leave. And you check how every guest gets home.

Save this before your next party, and tag the friend who always hosts.

Water between pegs. Never drink and drive.

#GharParty #LargeSahab #EkLarge #PartyHost

slides.title: Hosting tonight? Large Sahab’s checklist.
slides.sub: Five things a good host never forgets.

slides.title: A water station.
slides.body: Jug and glasses, where everyone can see them. Water between pegs.

slides.title: Enough real glasses.
slides.body: So nobody ends up with a paper cup.

slides.title: Dinner by ten.
slides.body: Chakna is a starter, not a meal.

slides.title: A sofa, made up.
slides.body: Pillow and blanket for anyone who shouldn’t head home tonight.

slides.title: Check how everyone gets home.
slides.body: Cab booked, or a sober driver. No exceptions.

slides.title: What’s on your host checklist?
slides.cta: Save this before your next party.
